items.notes: Quote: '`zsh -fc 'source ./rg.zsh'` gives `_rg:341: command not found: _arguments` and exit code 1. Sourcing after `compinit` works.' Checked: zsh -f sourcing rg.zsh without compinit prints '_rg:341: command not found: _arguments' (exit 1); with compinit loaded first it registers ${_comps[rg]}=_rg. So the fact is accurate, but register non_defect 2 ('compdef might not ... exist when needed') rules that the `(( ! $+functions[compdef] ))` half deliberately falls back to the pre-PR unconditional call; sourcing before compinit behaves exactly as before the PR (no regression), and needing compinit before a compdef-based completion is the normal zshcompsys convention. Accurate but below the material bar per the register.

It is speculative, shows no demonstrated wrong behaviour caused by this PR, and is below the threshold.
